text.en: Android updates install from the original download to save storage. Finished downloads appear in Cache management.
text.zh: Android 更新直接使用原始 APK 安装，节省存储空间。下载完成的安装包会出现在「缓存管理」。

text.en: About app groups related features and includes Cache management, with total space, file paths, and sizes in decimal units (KB, MB, and GB).
text.zh: 「关于应用」按用途分区，并新增「缓存管理」，可查看总占用、文件相对路径和分类明细，大小按十进制显示为 KB、MB 或 GB。

text.en: The Notes website reuses cached static resources when you reopen or refresh a page.
text.zh: 重新打开或刷新摘星官网时，会复用未变化的静态资源缓存。

text.en: Website resources download concurrently in smaller parts, can continue in the background, and show active and saved progress for each file in Cache management. MiSans uses a shorter filename. On Android, opening the app also retries unfinished website downloads.
text.zh: 官网资源使用较小分片并行下载，支持后台继续和断点续传，可在「缓存管理」查看各文件的实时进度和已保存的断点。MiSans 字体使用更短的文件名。Android 打开应用时会主动续传未完成的官网资源。

text.en: Refresh any page opened in the app's web view.
text.zh: 所有应用内网页均支持通过右上角按钮刷新。

text.en: Browse the official Notes website from About app.
text.zh: 在「关于应用」中直接浏览摘星官网。

text.en: The website homepage preview is centered, and all three cards use the same corner radius.
text.zh: 摘星官网首页的预览截图居中显示，三个卡片采用统一圆角。

text.en: The Notes website now uses the Xiaomi MiSans font.
text.zh: 摘星官网改用小米 MiSans 字体。

text.en: The Notes website keeps navigation items evenly spaced and steady when switching pages. In narrow windows, navigation moves to an adaptive left sidebar. The website lets you set the language, appearance, and text size. The open-source notices menu opens the selected platform directly. The release notes page includes the download link in its navigation.
text.zh: 摘星官网为导航项留出统一间距，切页时保持位置稳定，在较窄的窗口中使用宽度自适应的左侧栏。官网支持设置语言、深色模式和字体大小。开源声明菜单可直达所选平台，更新日志页保留下载入口。

text.en: The website navigation and browser tab use the same rounded Notes icon.
text.zh: 摘星官网的导航栏和浏览器标签页使用同一个圆角图标。

text.en: The Notes website downloads the APK directly from its downloads page.
text.zh: 摘星官网的下载页可直接下载 APK。

text.en: Fixed blurry text that could appear when the Notes website first loaded.
text.zh: 修复摘星官网首次加载时文字可能发糊的问题。

text.en: Fixed a brief flash of the simplified page when refreshing the Notes website.
text.zh: 修复刷新摘星官网时简版页面一闪而过的问题。

text.en: Checking during a background download shows its status or lets you switch to a newer update.
text.zh: 后台下载期间再次检查，可查看下载状态或切换到更新的版本。

text.en: The mainland edition prompts you to install the update when the background download finishes.
text.zh: 中国大陆版在后台下载完成后会弹窗提示安装。

text.en: Update checks are available in development builds of both Android editions.
text.zh: Android 的 mainland 和 global 开发构建均可检查更新。

text.en: The mainland edition downloads updates in the background and lets you choose when to install them.
text.zh: 中国大陆版支持在后台下载更新，下载完成后可按需安装。

text.en: Check for updates in About and see what’s new. The mainland edition can download and install updates.
text.zh: 可在关于应用中检查更新并查看新版内容，中国大陆版支持下载安装。

text.en: All app versions share the latest online open-source software notices for their platform.
text.zh: 所有应用版本共用各自平台的最新在线开源软件声明。

text.en: View published release notes in the app with Android and iOS filters.
text.zh: 在应用内查看官网更新日志，可切换 Android 和 iOS。

text.en: Open-source notices show the app theme's background until the web content is ready to draw after rotation.
text.zh: 旋转屏幕后，开源软件声明在网页可绘制前显示应用主题背景，避免短暂黑块。

text.en: Mail details retain the subject, close button, and message when the page resumes after screen rotation.
text.zh: 修复旋转屏幕后邮件详情的标题、关闭按钮和正文丢失的问题。

text.en: The open-source notices title bar stays clear of the status bar after screen rotation.
text.zh: 修复旋转屏幕后开源软件声明标题栏与状态栏重叠的问题。

text.en: The web view uses the app theme's background while open-source notices and project pages load. Fast loads no longer flash the progress bar.
text.zh: 开源软件声明和项目来源加载期间，网页视图使用当前应用主题的背景色，快速加载完成时不显示进度条。

text.en: Read online open-source software notices in the app, with the list and selected licenses, notices, or project sources side by side on wide screens. Project sources open inside the app.
text.zh: 可在应用内在线查看开源软件声明，宽屏可并排查看列表与所选许可证、NOTICE 或项目来源，项目来源在应用内打开。

text.en: Favorites fills the available width on wide windows until you open an email.
text.zh: 在宽窗口中，收藏列表在打开邮件前会占满可用宽度。

text.en: Passkey management asks you to verify again only when your session requires it.
text.zh: 通行密钥管理仅在会话需要重新验证时显示相应提示。

text.en: Account requests can run alongside each other. When a session expires, the app tries to renew it when needed.
text.zh: 账号请求可以并行执行，会话过期后应用会在需要时尝试续期。

text.en: Scroll from either side of the screen on Personal information and Passkeys.
text.zh: 可从屏幕两侧的留白处滑动，滚动个人信息和通行密钥页面。

text.en: The passkey management page keeps its list and pending actions when you rotate the screen.
text.zh: 旋转屏幕时，通行密钥管理页会保留列表和待确认的操作。

text.en: Use your password manager to fill the current password when changing your email. The autofill highlight matches the rounded field.
text.zh: 修改邮箱时可通过密码管理器自动填充当前密码，填充高亮与输入框圆角对齐。

text.en: Personal information keeps edits when you rotate the screen. Account fields match sign-in. Edit forms slide open and closed, and the new email and verification code fields animate into view. The button shows the next step.
text.zh: 个人信息页在旋转屏幕时保留编辑进度，输入框与登录页风格一致，编辑表单滑动展开和收起，修改邮箱时，新邮箱和验证码输入框逐步展开，底部按钮会显示当前步骤。

text.en: All Android and iOS builds now offer email registration by default, with passkey sign-in on supported devices.
text.zh: 所有 Android 和 iOS 构建默认开放邮箱注册，支持通行密钥的设备也可使用通行密钥登录。

text.en: Use your registered email to sign in with a password or passkey. Registration tells you if the email is already in use.
text.zh: 使用已注册邮箱进行密码或通行密钥登录。注册时会提示邮箱已被使用。

text.en: Adding a passkey explains when no password manager is available or when the selected manager already has a passkey for your Notes account. Passkey setup and sign-in let you retry if the service stops responding.
text.zh: 添加通行密钥时，如果没有可用的密码管理器，或所选管理器已保存此 Notes 账号的通行密钥，应用会给出对应提示。添加或登录时，如果通行密钥服务未响应，应用会结束等待并提示重试。

text.en: Autofill highlights follow the rounded corners of the sign-in fields and the email verification fields during registration.
text.zh: 登录页和注册页「验证邮箱」步骤的自动填充高亮现在与输入框圆角对齐。

text.en: Shortened the Chinese label on the passkey sign-in button.
text.zh: 登录页按钮文案简化为「通行密钥登录」。

text.en: Support adding and using passkeys with Xiaomi Password Manager.
text.zh: 兼容小米密码管理器添加通行密钥和使用通行密钥登录。

text.en: Manage passkeys on a dedicated page that shows the password manager and device brand used at creation, when available.
text.zh: 可在独立页面管理通行密钥，并查看可识别的创建服务和设备品牌。

text.en: Taps and swipes no longer reach the sign-in or registration screen through the loading overlay.
text.zh: 登录和注册时，加载遮罩会拦截点击和滑动。

text.en: Register with a verified email and manage your username, email, and avatar in Profile.
text.zh: 支持通过邮箱验证码注册，并在个人信息页设置用户名、修改邮箱和更换头像。

text.en: Signed-in accounts can load their profile and sync avatar changes across devices.
text.zh: 登录后可获取账号资料，更换的头像会同步到其他设备。

text.en: Check for app updates and view release history and open-source notices on the Notes website.
text.zh: 支持检查应用更新，并可在 Notes 官网查看历史更新与开源声明。

text.en: Save and fill your Notes account name and password with your Android password manager.
text.zh: 支持通过 Android 系统密码管理器保存并自动填充 Notes 账号和密码。

text.en: On builds connected to Notes authentication, sign in with an account name and password without providing an email address, or with a passkey on supported devices. Find account, general, security, and app settings under clear section headings.
text.zh: 接入 Notes 认证服务的版本支持使用账户名和密码登录，无需提供邮箱。符合条件的设备也可以使用通行密钥登录。设置页用标题区分账户、通用、安全和应用。

text.en: Enable biometric unlock in Settings to verify with biometrics or your device screen lock when the app starts. If the device has no secure screen lock, the unlock screen explains how to restore access.
text.zh: 可在设置中开启生物识别解锁，启动应用时使用生物识别或设备锁屏凭据验证。设备未设置安全锁屏时，解锁页会提示如何恢复访问。

text.en: Let dialogs fit their content up to 80% of the app window width, preserving minimum margins and keeping long content clear of system bars.
text.zh: 弹窗按内容需要展开，最大宽度为应用窗口的 80%，保留默认最小边距，长内容避开状态栏和底部系统区域。

text.en: Match the sign-up fields to the sign-in page's rounded corners, borders, and spacing, and use the shared loading indicator while a request is in progress.
text.zh: 注册账号页面的输入框改用与登录页一致的圆角、描边和间距，请求处理期间显示统一加载提示。

text.en: Sign-in and sign-up share one password rule: at least 8 characters counted in code points, two of letters, numbers and symbols, and no emoji.
text.zh: 登录与注册使用同一条密码规则：至少 8 个字符（按字符计数），包含字母、数字、特殊符号中的两种，且不能使用表情符号。

text.en: Give the passkey and registration labels more room inside their buttons on the sign-in screen.
text.zh: 增加登录页通行密钥和注册按钮的左右内边距，让文字避开圆角。

text.en: Keep sign-up progress when the screen rotates and center the send-code button against the email field.
text.zh: 注册时旋转屏幕会保留当前进度，发送验证码按钮与邮箱输入框垂直居中。

text.en: Generate theme colors from the desktop wallpaper, including on Android 9–11.
text.zh: 主题色直接跟随桌面壁纸变化，并支持 Android 9–11。

text.en: Open-source notices use fixed detail pages and display only the selected declaration.
text.zh: 开源软件声明使用固定详情页，每次仅显示所选声明。

text.en: Group open-source notices into Google / JetBrains components and other third-party components, with shortcut buttons at the top.
text.zh: 开源软件声明按 Google / JetBrains 组件和其他第三方组件分类展示，顶部增加分类定位按钮。

text.en: Open-source notices share one set of actions per project series, with all included modules displayed above the actions.
text.zh: 开源软件声明同系列库共用一组按钮，包含的模块完整显示在按钮上方。

text.en: Settings selection dialogs remain visible after rotating to a shorter window without needing to scroll.
text.zh: 修复设置选择弹窗在旋转到较矮窗口后需要滚动才能恢复显示的问题。

text.en: Release notes use bold category headings and list additions, improvements, then fixes.
text.zh: 更新内容分类标题加粗，统一按新增、优化、修复的顺序展示。

text.en: About app content scrolls behind the bottom safe area and keeps its scroll position when returning from open-source notices.
text.zh: 关于应用内容延伸至底部安全区域，修复从开源软件声明返回后滚动位置改变的问题。

text.en: View release notes offline from About app.
text.zh: 在关于应用中离线查看版本更新日志。

text.en: Release history adapts to wide windows with a multi-column waterfall layout.
text.zh: 历史更新根据窗口宽度自适应展示为单列、双列或三列瀑布流。

text.en: Current-version notes, the startup dialog and release history now show the same categories and content.
text.zh: 统一关于应用、启动弹窗与历史更新的分类和内容展示。

text.en: On unfolded foldables, switch between one column and hinge-aligned columns with a rotating icon.
text.zh: 折叠设备全开时默认单列，点击右上角图标切换铰链分列，图标带旋转过渡。

text.en: Release cards fill their available pane width while preserving hinge clearance.
text.zh: 历史更新卡片铺满所属窗格的可用宽度，并保留铰链避让。

text.en: Keep hinge-aligned release cards stable during predictive back gestures.
text.zh: 修复预测性返回手势导致铰链分列卡片宽度与文字换行变化。

text.en: See what’s new on the first launch of each app version.
text.zh: 每个版本首次启动时弹窗展示本次更新内容。

text.en: Keep dialogs centered when the system gesture indicator is hidden.
text.zh: 修复隐藏系统手势提示线时弹窗未居中的问题。
